record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: Fix a positive integer r. Let A(X) be as in Question 6, and define A(X,r) to be the set of rank-r vector bundles E on X such that h^i(E ⊗ L^⊗t)=0 for all integers t, all 1 ≤ i ≤ n−1, and every ample line bundle L in A(X). What properties characterize the subset A(X,r)?

evidence.quote: Question 7. What are the properties of the subset A(X, r) of all rank r vector bundles E on X such that h^i(E ⊗ L^⊗t) = 0 for all t ∈ Z, all i = 1, . . . , n − 1 and all L ∈ A(X)?

artifact.category_tag: ACM and arithmetically Cohen–Macaulay vector bundles
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth projective variety of dimension n ≥ 2 over an algebraically closed field, and let A(X) denote the set of all ample line bundles on X. For a fixed positive integer r, define

  A(X, r) := { E : E is a rank-r vector bundle on X such that, for every L ∈ A(X), every integer t, and every i with 1 ≤ i ≤ n − 1, one has h^i(X, E ⊗ L^{⊗ t}) = 0 }.

(That is, A(X, r) consists of rank-r vector bundles with universal intermediate-cohomology vanishing against every ample line bundle and all its integer powers.)

Describe and characterize the subset A(X, r): determine its structural properties (e.g. nonemptiness, decomposability, splitting behavior, restriction conditions on X and r, possible classification of its elements).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as an explicitly posed open question in a list of 25 open questions on vector bundles and their moduli. No subsequent work providing a full characterization of A(X,r) was located; related results exist for ACM bundles and Horrocks-type splitting criteria, but the question as stated remains open.

status_evidence.claim: The question characterizing A(X,r) is posed as an open problem.
